messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=private-vpc-egress, incident=P-4829 — symptom: sustained packet loss from customer vpc -> control plane (10.4.0.0/16). Auto-escalation set to 5m.

pagerduty: Page sent to @maya oncall (primary).

maya oncall: acked. I'm looking. Can someone drop recent graphs (egress pktloss, controlplane heartbeats) here?

tom sre: past 10m we see spikes in egress packet loss on edge-node-7 in us-west-2, correlates with TCP retransmits to 52.11.22.33 (relay gw). P95 latency on control-plane keepalive ~6s -> timing out.

alina support: customer reported 502s on their inference requests ~15m ago. Ticket 78921. They say intermittent, mostly during larger payloads.

maya oncall: thanks. raj, any config changes on customer side or recent deployments?

raj customer-eng: customer's network team says they didn't change anything. They did start a bulk data sync about ~20m ago which increased outbound connections. Might be NAT exhaustion on their edge. I've asked for an immediate confirmation.

tom sre: running quick checks from edge-node-7:
```
# ping -c 5 52.11.22.33
PING 52.11.22.33 (52.11.22.33): 56 data bytes
--- 52.11.22.33 ping statistics ---
5 packets transmitted, 3 packets received, 40% packet loss
```
And tcpdump shows many retransmits with MSS clamping in effect.

maya oncall: interesting. Could be customer NAT + our egress path causing fragmentation. Any firewall logs showing RSTs?

tom sre: firewall on customer side shows ephemeral port reuse warnings and a burst of outbound flows. Also seeing ICMP "fragmentation needed" from downstream provider intermittently.

alina support: customer confirms they're running a DB sync to an external endpoint at ~10k connections. They're going to throttle but need a short workaround from us.

maya oncall: mitigation plan: 1) try restarting agent-relay on edge-node-7 to clear stuck NAT sessions (low-risk, 1 node). 2) add temporary iptables rule to do MSS clamping to avoid fragmentation issues. 3) if that fails, shift traffic for this customer to fallback relay (edge-node-3) via routing policy. Execute 1->2 in next 5m.

li devops: I can do the agent restart and add iptables rule. Will run from bastion.

maya oncall: go for it. Please post commands you run.

li devops: on bastion (us-west-2):
```
ssh ubuntu@edge-node-7
sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent-relay
# apply MSS clamp
sudo iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp -o eth0 -m tcpmss --mss 1401:1536 -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1400
```
Restart took ~8s, agent-relay logs show reconnect to control plane.

li devops: after restart, I see agent-relay jitter drop and controlplane keepalive latency back to ~80ms. Packetloss down to ~2%.

tom sre: confirmed from metrics: egress packet loss back to normal around 2145679900. Some tail latency remains for a few flows.

maya oncall: nice. raj please coordinate with customer to throttle their sync for 10m while we monitor.

raj customer-eng: told them to throttle to 1/10th. They acknowledged and started throttling.

alina support: customer reports errors dropping from ~30/min to ~1/min now. They're happy for now but want root cause.

maya oncall: follow-up actions: - add permanent MSS clamp to edge-node pool for customers behind older CPEs - add a metric to alert on high ephemeral port utilization per-customer - update runbook for agent-relay restart steps.

tom sre: I'll open internal ticket INFRA-1234 for MSS policy and metric.

maya oncall: severity: SEV2 (customer-visible 10-20% error rate for a small number of customers). Impacted customers: 2 (customer A, customer B). Incident start: 2145678905, mitigated at ~2145679900. Estimated customer downtime window: ~15m.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged and marked as partially mitigated. Auto-resolve in 30m if no recurrence.

incident-bot: Note: I'm posting the standard on-call handoff checklist.

maya oncall: next oncall at 2145682600 is @li devops — I'll hand off for postmortem and RCA. Li, please pick up and run the postmortem template (link: https://redwood.internal/incident-postmortem).

li devops: got it, taking handoff. I'll collect tcpdumps, egress flow logs, and customer NAT table output. Planning RCA and will share by EOD.

alina support: I've updated customer ticket 78921 with timeline and mitigation steps. Customer asked for a timeline for permanent fix; I'll route that after RCAs.

maya oncall: thanks everyone. closing slack thread for now — will reopen if pagerduty re-fires. :white_check_mark:
